bStocks, Ondo Stocks and xStocks on BNB Smart Chain: which contracts are genuine

A contract is genuine when its issuer's list has the address and its runtime code and proxy beacon/admin match the rule measured on every contract of that list. An unlisted contract using the same ticker or name is on no list but uses the exact symbol or the family marker of a listed contract — a bridged copy, a test deployment or another claimant. Anything in between is unknown, with the reason.

Independent open-source tool. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected with Binance, Ondo Finance or Backed (xStocks). Information only, not investment advice. Nothing here is an offer or a recommendation to buy or sell anything.

Unlisted contracts using the same ticker or name

2253 contracts on BNB Smart Chain use the symbol or the name of an issuer-listed contract without being on the issuer's list (bStocks: 651 · Ondo Stocks: 1113 · xStocks: 489). By what their own name and symbol say: bridged copy: 28 · test contract: 33 · other issuer: 42 · claimant not identified: 2150. This describes a claim, not an intent: bridged copies and test deployments are among them. Counts of unlisted contracts using the same ticker or name are lower bounds: each search returns at most one page, and only the queries listed in the method were run.

one search on chain 56 per underlying ticker of the Binance-listed contracts, plus "xStock", "Ondo Tokenized" and "bStocks"; when a page came back full, also the family symbols of that ticker. A result counts as an unlisted contract using the same ticker or name when it is on no list and either its own name() carries the family marker ("xStock", "(Ondo Tokenized)"), or its own symbol() is exactly the symbol of a genuine family contract (case included) and its name repeats that symbol or shares a distinctive word with the genuine name. The kind of claimant (bridged copy, test contract, other issuer) is read from the contract's own name and symbol only; otherwise it is "not identified". 782 searches, 164 came back full (50 rows).
